sourceEnglishSpeaking: Stop installation when the nail gun is burying nails and ask for an adjustment.
candidateObjective: 釘が深く打ち込まれすぎた状態を見つけ、釘打ち機の調整を求める。
candidateFocus: ～すぎる describes excessive depth; ～ないでください gives a negative instruction. ～てから orders checking depth before continuing.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 釘打ち機を調整してください。
作業員はコンプレッサーとホースを確認します。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: A worker checks the compressor and the hose.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 空気圧を下げてください。
その隣に新しい釘を打ってください。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: Put a new nail next to it.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 釘を深く打ち込みすぎないでください。
archivedForms.meaningEnglish: to nail, to drive a nail

archivedSpeaking.opening: 作業を止めてください。釘が深すぎます。釘打ち機を調整してください。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Stop installation when the nail gun is burying nails and ask for an adjustment.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the source sequence: foreman hears nail gun, notices overdriven nails, stops work, checks compressor and hose, gives lower-pressure and adjust-gun commands, proposes a nearby new nail, then checks depth on several shingles. These commands are source evidence, not approved universal repair or tool settings. Confirm the selected asphalt-shingle product, manufacturer instructions, nail-gun/compressor guidance, repair location and responsible operator before selecting Japanese instructions. Archived generic シングル材 needs product-specific review. Current source curriculum has no authored verb-example list; archived forms remain conditional evidence. No selected learner/audio text or progress identity is created.
